### From Adopted Budget FY2025-26 (2026-06-03)

*From: Adopted Budget FY2025-26 (2026-06-03)*

- Schertz FY2025-26 budget totals $272.7 million with operating budget of $140.8 million and capital budget of $72.5 million [SOURCE: Adopted Budget FY2025-26]
- Property tax rate set at $0.5118 per $100 valuation, a 1.1% increase [SOURCE: Adopted Budget FY2025-26]
- City population is 43,969 residents with median household income of $100,325 [SOURCE: Adopted Budget FY2025-26]
- Median home value in Schertz is $323,972.05 [SOURCE: Adopted Budget FY2025-26]
- Unemployment rate as of August 2025 is 4.5%, slightly higher than San Antonio's 4.3% [SOURCE: Adopted Budget FY2025-26]
- Disabled Veterans Homestead Exemption represents $7.08 billion in exempt property value, causing $5.5 million annual revenue loss (19% of property tax collections) [SOURCE: Adopted Budget FY2025-26]
- DVHS exemptions grew 8.6% in FY2025-26, down from 22% three-year average [SOURCE: Adopted Budget FY2025-26]
- State DVHS aid program currently funds only 17.5% of total requests statewide [SOURCE: Adopted Budget FY2025-26]
- Budget adds 26 new positions: 10 General Fund, 6 Water/Sewer, 4 EMS, 6 Drainage [SOURCE: Adopted Budget FY2025-26]
- Fire Station 4 will be staffed with 12 employees at annual cost of $1.3 million [SOURCE: Adopted Budget FY2025-26]
